sin.description: A PHP file function reads, lists, stats or writes the disk outside the Files funnel. The rule selects the language's own function-call kind (Expr_FuncCall), so a method or static call that shares the name ($linker->unlink(), Task::file()) never matches, and the names unlink, rename, file, copy, link and stat are judged too.
sin.name: direct-file-access
sin.rule: Read, list, stat and write files through App\Contracts\Files\Files with a FilePath in its place; only the Files primitives (app/Support/LocalFiles and its kin, and app/Files until it moves) touch the disk, and a method the user settled as outside the places carries #[OutsideThePlaces]. The skill direct-file-access names the Files method for each function.
